participantNames.description: Names of the speakers that appear in the track.

bgVolume.description: Volume of the background audio of a dubbing track, from 0 to 2.

speakerVolumes.description: Volume of each speaker of a dubbing track, by speaker identifier.

speakerVoiceSettings.description: Voice settings of each speaker of a dubbing track, by speaker identifier.

expandToContent.description: Audio-only dubbing tracks only, present when it is on: each segment grows to the natural length of its speech instead of fitting the original timing. Read only: it is chosen with `expandToContent` of the dubbing request, and `PUT .../subtitles` does not accept it.
